extracted.intended_audience: journalists and members of the news media
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for members of the news media on how to contact the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, what information to provide, where to find background resources, and how to request expert commentary or subscribe to the foundation's newsletter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who should contact
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are a member of the news media, please use the phone number or email address below to leave a detailed message.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This guidance is explicitly addressed only to members of the news media (journalists).

rubrics_metrics.name: Media contact message contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Include your name, press affiliation, phone number, questions, and deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leave a detailed message containing all listed fields so the media team can respond appropriately and meet your deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact methods and details
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use either the telephone number or the email address to leave your detailed media inquiry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided media resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Find more information about the foundation's mission, work, and grantmaking via the links below. Foundation Fact Sheet; Financial Information; Committed grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these resources for background information before contacting the media team or referencing the foundation in reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request expert perspective
rubrics_metrics.description: Our program leaders and other experts can offer perspective and background to members of the media on a wide range of topics, from development finance and policy to gender equality, climate adaptation, food and nutrition security, financial inclusion, and global health R&D.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists may request interviews or background from program leaders and experts on the listed topic areas; use the contact channels to arrange such conversations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscribe to The Optimist newsletter
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscribe to The Optimist to get weekly updates on the latest in global health, gender equality, education, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signing up provides regular updates and may reduce the need for ad hoc inquiries for routine news and updates.
